drafts[] (week of Jan 5, 2027 — students return Tue Jan 5; week key 2027-01-04) -> create content/paced/2027-01/review.json with every draft row (drop 'batch' and 'closerLook') and content/paced/2027-01/approvals.json {batch:'2027-01', reviewedOn, reviewPage, decisions (approved/removed drafts only), notes, edits:{}, held:{}}. Apply any note that asks for a wording fix as an edit (or hold it and tell Trace if unclear). dryRunScript is the Python used to test this bundle (python3 apply.py <repo> <bundle>); it follows these steps and may be used.
